snap.title: OkNetwork – Job Finder & Alerts
snap.summary: Job finder for job seekers: alerts for remote and tech jobs that fit you
snap.description:
OkNetwork (knet) is a job finder and job search app for job seekers. It watches job boards, company career pages and RSS feeds, and sends you a notification when a new job posting matches your skills, experience and location. Find a job faster, without refreshing job sites all day.

- Job alerts for remote jobs, tech jobs and developer jobs (software engineer, frontend, backend, full-stack, data, DevOps, QA, product and more), plus work from home and relocation jobs
- Match score for every job, with the reasons: tech stack, role, seniority, soft skills and where you can work from
- Sources: Remotive, Remote OK, Arbeitnow, Jobicy, Get on Board, relocate.me, and company careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Breezy, BambooHR and Workday, plus any RSS feed
- Duplicate postings from different job boards are merged, so each job shows up once
- Job application tracker for your job hunt: applied, screening, interview, offer, with private notes
- Employers and recruiters can post a job for free; matching candidates get notified
- Private by design: your profile stays on your computer. No account, no ads, no tracking

Great for a career change, a first job, freelance and contract work, or finding your next remote job. Five themes, including dark mode, Dracula and Pride.
